name: Suzuki Hikaru
source:
A 1st year middle schooler.
A bright and energetic boy who plays basketball.
He works his hardest to be kind for other people's sake and joined the basketball club to work hard in place of [url=/c51797]Chihiro[/url] who had to give up her dream.
After he met her at the entrance ceremony he has been interested in [url=/c51797]Sayaka[/url].
